```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

source("R/acsf_app_loader.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-apps
#| include: false

# Each app is run minus its shinyApp() call, so we get exactly the data it builds at
# startup - same files, same loading code. See R/acsf_app_loader.R.
APP_FILES <- c(
  sales_vis  = "ACSF app/app.R",
  ts_weekly  = "ACSF weekly/App_ts_weekly.R",
  coding     = "Coding mgt app/app.R",
  wt_compare = "Coding mgt app/App_wt_compare.R"
) %>%
  map_chr(\(f) file.path(params$root, f))

apps <- if (params$demo) list() else map(APP_FILES, safe_load_app)

# Sourced AFTER the apps, so if an app's custom_styles.R defines something with the
# same name, the report's version wins.
source("R/acsf_plot_helpers.R")

# TODO: charts still run on simulated data. Replace each piece with the real object
# from `apps` as the plot functions get wired up, e.g.
#   dat$coding_items <- get("<object name>", envir = apps$coding)
dat <- make_demo_data()
```

```{r}
#| label: demo-banner
#| results: asis

msg <- if (params$demo)
  "**Demo mode** - apps not loaded; everything below is simulated."
else
  "**Work in progress** - apps are loaded (see @sec-sources) but charts still use simulated data until the plot functions are wired up."

cat('::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}', msg, ":::", sep = "\n")
```

# Overview

<!-- One paragraph: what this document is for, who it's for, what's been signed off. -->

This document collates the key steps in producing ACSF for **`r params$ref_period`**: data receipt,
weekly time-series checks, product coding to AUSNUT, weight comparisons, and the final sales outputs.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-key-checks
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of key checks"

# TODO: replace with real QA results computed from `dat`
tibble(
  Step   = c("Data receipt", "Weekly TS checks", "Coding coverage", "Weights", "Sales outputs"),
  Check  = c("All retailers / weeks received",
             "No unexplained breaks post adjustment",
             "Uncoded share of sales below threshold",
             "Large weight changes explained",
             "Movements vs previous period explained"),
  Status = c("✅", "✅", "⚠️", "⏳", "⏳"),
  Notes  = c("", "", "See @sec-coding", "", "")
) %>%
  kable()
```

# Data sources {#sec-sources}

What each app loaded at startup. A **LOAD FAILED** row means the app itself couldn't start;
the message is the error the app would have shown.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sources
#| tbl-cap: "Data objects built by each app"

if (length(apps)) {
  imap(apps, \(env, app) app_inventory(env) %>% mutate(app = app, .before = 1)) %>%
    list_rbind() %>%
    kable()
} else {
  cat("Demo mode: apps not loaded.")
}
```

# Data receipt {#sec-receipt}

<!-- Source files, retailers, weeks covered, row counts, anything late or resupplied. -->

```{r}
#| label: receipt-summary

dat$ts_weekly %>%
  filter(stage == "Pre") %>%
  summarise(`First week` = min(week), `Last week` = max(week),
            Weeks = n_distinct(week), Series = n_distinct(series)) %>%
  kable()
```

# Weekly time series (App_ts_weekly) {#sec-ts}

<!-- What was adjusted and why. Call out specific weeks. -->

```{r}
#| label: fig-ts-weekly
#| fig-cap: "Weekly sales, pre and post adjustment"

plot_ts_weekly(dat$ts_weekly)
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Adjustment notes
- Week of ...: retailer resupply, ...
- Week of ...: outlier treated by ...
:::

## Size of adjustments

```{r}
#| label: tbl-adjustments
#| tbl-cap: "Largest weekly adjustments (post minus pre)"

dat$ts_weekly %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Diff = Post - Pre, `Diff (%)` = 100 * Diff / Pre) %>%
  slice_max(abs(Diff), n = 10) %>%
  kable(digits = 1)
```

# Coding management {#sec-coding}

<!-- New products this period, auto-coding hit rate, what's still outstanding. -->

::: {.panel-tabset}
## By sales value
```{r}
#| label: fig-coding-sales
plot_coding_coverage(dat$coding_summary, measure = "sales",
                     title = "Coding coverage - share of sales value")
```

## By item count
```{r}
#| label: fig-coding-items
plot_coding_coverage(dat$coding_summary, measure = "n_items",
                     title = "Coding coverage - share of items")
```
:::

## Top uncoded items

```{r}
#| label: tbl-uncoded
table_uncoded(dat$coding_items, n = 20)
```
